id_prefixes.note: Public form of an internal event ID (execution.outbox_event is transient; durable references live in integrations.webhook_delivery.event_public_id).
Per-request identifier; exists only in responses, logs, and traces (no persistence).

error_codes.safe_message: The request could not be read.
This page link is no longer valid. Start again from the first page.
error_codes.disclosure_rule: Same for tampered, foreign, or expired cursors.

error_codes.safe_message: Sign in again to continue.
error_codes.disclosure_rule: Identical for missing, invalid, expired, and revoked credentials, and for unknown inbound endpoints.

error_codes.safe_message: You don't have permission to do that.
error_codes.disclosure_rule: Only for targets the caller can read (ST-42).

error_codes.safe_message: Confirm it's you to continue.
error_codes.disclosure_rule: Only for readable targets; carries a step_up challenge.

error_codes.safe_message: This action needs a person to confirm it.
This action needs approval first.
error_codes.disclosure_rule: Carries approval reference; the target must be readable.

error_codes.safe_message: This automation or integration is paused until it has an owner with access.
Your plan doesn't include this feature.
error_codes.disclosure_rule: Never for unreadable targets; never implies data access.

error_codes.safe_message: This would exceed a usage limit.
This workspace is read-only.
The requested resource was not found.
error_codes.disclosure_rule: Uniform for nonexistent and unauthorized targets: same status, body, headers, cache directives, and timing envelope.

error_codes.safe_message: That operation isn't supported here.
This item was changed by someone else.
error_codes.disclosure_rule: Conflict payload filtered by field policy.

error_codes.safe_message: This version is locked as evidence and can't be changed.
This file is still being checked.
This file can't be downloaded.
This request key was already used for a different request.
This request is still being processed.
The request is too large.
That content type isn't supported.
Some fields need attention.
error_codes.disclosure_rule: Issue codes never distinguish hidden from nonexistent fields or records (unsupported_field, invalid_reference).

error_codes.safe_message: The uploaded file didn't match its checksum.
Include the version you are changing.
Too many requests. Try again shortly.
Something went wrong on our side.
error_codes.disclosure_rule: No stack traces, SQL, or tenant data.

error_codes.safe_message: A connected service is unavailable. Core features still work.
error_codes.disclosure_rule: Names the dependency class only (ai_provider, integration, storage).

error_codes.safe_message: The service is temporarily unavailable.
Some items couldn't be completed.
This took too long and was stopped.
This stopped at a configured limit.
This was stopped because access or policy changed.

scopes.description: Read records the principal can read.
Create, update, assign, relate, upload, complete records.
Assign tasks to agents and control runs.
Create Inbox items for the principal's owner.

parameters.name: IDEMPOTENCY_RETENTION
parameters.meaning: Minimum retention of idempotency records; must cover the offline replay window.

parameters.name: OUTBOX_REPLAY_WINDOW
parameters.meaning: How long dispatched outbox rows remain for replay.

parameters.name: JOB_LEASE_DURATION
parameters.meaning: Lease length per queue.

parameters.name: JOB_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL
parameters.meaning: Heartbeat interval; < lease duration / 3.

parameters.name: JOB_BACKOFF_BASE
parameters.meaning: Backoff base delay per queue.

parameters.name: JOB_BACKOFF_CAP
parameters.meaning: Maximum backoff delay per queue.

parameters.name: JOB_MAX_ATTEMPTS
parameters.meaning: Retry cap per job kind.

parameters.name: JOB_TIMEOUT
parameters.meaning: Execution timeout per job kind.

parameters.name: WORKSPACE_CONCURRENCY_CAP
parameters.meaning: Per-workspace concurrent job cap per queue (fairness).

parameters.name: WEBHOOK_TIMESTAMP_TOLERANCE
parameters.meaning: Accepted clock skew for signed webhooks.

parameters.name: WEBHOOK_DISABLE_THRESHOLD
parameters.meaning: Consecutive-failure policy that disables an endpoint.

parameters.name: WEBHOOK_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT
parameters.meaning: Outbound delivery response timeout.

parameters.name: SSE_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL
parameters.meaning: Heartbeat comment interval.

parameters.name: SSE_BUFFER_LIMIT
parameters.meaning: Notices buffered per stream for Last-Event-ID resume.

parameters.name: SSE_MAX_STREAMS_PER_PRINCIPAL
parameters.meaning: Concurrent streams per principal.

parameters.name: SIGNED_URL_LIFETIME
parameters.meaning: Lifetime of signed upload and download URLs in seconds; never stored, logged, or sent in notifications or exports; default 300, range 30–3600.

parameters.name: UPLOAD_SESSION_LIFETIME
parameters.meaning: Lifetime of an upload session in seconds; an expired, unfinished session releases its reserved bytes and quarantined object; default 3600, range 300–86400.

parameters.name: STEP_UP_WINDOW
parameters.meaning: Validity of a verified step-up token.

parameters.name: STEP_UP_CHALLENGE_LIFETIME
parameters.meaning: Validity of an unverified challenge.

parameters.name: STEP_UP_MAX_ATTEMPTS
parameters.meaning: Failed verifications after which a challenge is stored as locked (terminal).

parameters.name: PAGE_LIMIT_DEFAULT
parameters.meaning: Default page size.

parameters.name: PAGE_LIMIT_MAX
parameters.meaning: Maximum page size (schema cap 200).

parameters.name: TOTAL_COUNT_CAP
parameters.meaning: Above this, totals are capped/estimated.

parameters.name: BULK_SYNC_LIMIT
parameters.meaning: Max items processed synchronously before a bulk request becomes a background operation.

parameters.name: ATOMIC_BULK_LIMIT
parameters.meaning: Max items in an atomic bulk request.

parameters.name: RATE_LIMIT_POLICIES
parameters.meaning: Request quotas per principal class.

parameters.name: DEPRECATION_NOTICE_PERIOD
parameters.meaning: Minimum notice before removing a deprecated public contract (product-owner decision).

parameters.name: EXPORT_LINK_LIFETIME
parameters.meaning: Export file download lifetime (0A parameter, OD-36).

parameters.name: IMPORT_ROLLBACK_PERIOD
parameters.meaning: Import rollback window (0A parameter, OD-40).

parameters.name: USAGE_WARNING_THRESHOLDS
parameters.meaning: Default warning thresholds as basis points of allowance.

parameters.name: UNDO_RETENTION
parameters.meaning: How long an operation remains undoable server-side.

parameters.name: PRINCIPAL_CONTEXT_ARRAY_MAX
parameters.meaning: Largest visibility-context array bound as a query parameter before the compiler switches to a transaction-scoped temporary table (0C §4.5).

parameters.name: INVITATION_LIFETIME
parameters.meaning: How long an invitation token stays acceptable before the invitation expires.

parameters.name: OWNERSHIP_TRANSFER_LIFETIME
parameters.meaning: How long a pending ownership transfer waits for the recipient before it expires.

parameters.name: FAVORITES_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most favorites one person may keep in one workspace; adding beyond it is refused with a limit error, never silently dropped.

parameters.name: RECENT_ITEMS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Recently viewed entries kept per person per workspace (the full Recently Viewed list); older visits are trimmed in the recording transaction.

parameters.name: RECENT_VISIT_COALESCE
parameters.meaning: Window in which a repeat visit to the same target is coalesced into the existing recent entry without another write.

parameters.name: VIEW_STATE_MAX_BYTES
parameters.meaning: Largest stored view-state document (serialized) accepted per view and device.

parameters.name: VIEW_STATE_TTL
parameters.meaning: How long stored per-device view state survives without being written before cleanup removes it.

parameters.name: PROJECT_DEPTH_MAX
parameters.meaning: Deepest project level a command accepts (root = 0) when creating, moving, duplicating, or generating projects. The database separately enforces an invariant ceiling of 32 that is not a runtime parameter.

parameters.name: TEMPLATE_ITEMS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most structural items (project, phases, milestones, criteria, scope items) one template version or recurrence snapshot may contain.

parameters.name: RECURRENCE_CATCHUP_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most missed occurrences one recurrence series may generate in a single catch-up run; later ones wait for the next run.

parameters.name: RECURRENCE_WORKSPACE_DISCOVERY_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most workspaces with due recurrence work one recurrence job run visits (default 200, range 1–1000). Workspaces are taken oldest-waiting first, so remaining work stays eligible for the next run.

parameters.name: RECURRENCE_SERIES_DISCOVERY_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most due recurrence series one job run processes in one workspace (default 50, range 1–500). Series are taken oldest-waiting first (last run, then id), so later series are never starved.

parameters.name: TASK_DEPTH_MAX
parameters.meaning: Deepest subtask level a command accepts (root = 0) when creating, reparenting, moving, or duplicating tasks; default 20, range 1–64. The database separately enforces an invariant ceiling of 64 that is not a runtime parameter.

parameters.name: TASK_SUBTREE_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most tasks one subtree operation touches (a move or a lifecycle command with include_subtasks, or a duplicate with include_subtasks); default 500, range 1–5000. Larger subtrees are refused before any change.

parameters.name: TASK_ITEMS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most checklist items, criteria items, and links each task holds (each kind counted separately); default 200, range 1–1000.

parameters.name: TASK_ASSIGNEES_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most active assignees on one task; default 20, range 1–100.

parameters.name: TASK_LABELS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most labels on one task; default 50, range 1–200.

parameters.name: BRAND_LABELS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most active and archived labels in one brand; default 1000, range 1–10000.

parameters.name: TASK_ESTIMATE_MINUTES_MAX
parameters.meaning: Largest estimate or remaining estimate, in minutes; default 100000, range 60–1000000.

parameters.name: WORKFLOW_STATUSES_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most statuses in one workflow; default 50, range 2–200.

parameters.name: WORKFLOW_TRANSITIONS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most transitions in one workflow; default 400, range 1–2000.

parameters.name: TRANSITION_REQUIREMENTS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most required fields on one transition; default 30, range 1–100.

parameters.name: TRANSITION_APPROVERS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most named approvers on one transition; default 10, range 1–50.

parameters.name: APPROVAL_EXPIRY_HOURS
parameters.meaning: How long an approval request stays valid; default 168, range 1–2160.

parameters.name: TRANSITION_PREVIEW_TTL_SECONDS
parameters.meaning: Lifetime of a signed transition preview fingerprint; default 600, range 60–3600.

parameters.name: FIELD_DEFINITIONS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most active field definitions at one scope; default 200, range 1–1000.

parameters.name: FIELD_OPTIONS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most options on one select field; default 200, range 2–1000.

parameters.name: FIELD_SETS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most active field sets at one scope; default 100, range 1–500.

parameters.name: FIELD_SET_ITEMS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most definitions in one field set version; default 100, range 1–500.

parameters.name: FIELD_TEXT_MAX
parameters.meaning: Longest custom text value in characters; default 5000, range 1–20000.

parameters.name: FIELD_PATTERN_MAX
parameters.meaning: Longest validation pattern in characters; default 200, range 1–1000.

parameters.name: FORMULA_SOURCE_MAX
parameters.meaning: Longest formula source in characters; default 2000, range 10–10000.

parameters.name: FORMULA_AST_NODES_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most nodes in a compiled formula; default 200, range 10–2000.

parameters.name: FORMULA_DEPTH_MAX
parameters.meaning: Deepest formula dependency chain; default 8, range 1–32.

parameters.name: FORMULA_REFS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most field references in one formula; default 20, range 1–100.

parameters.name: FIELD_VALUE_BULK_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most records migrated by one status or option replacement command; default 500, range 1–5000.

parameters.name: TASK_STALE_ACTIVE_DAYS
parameters.meaning: Days without a meaningful update after which an active or blocked task is stale (OD-17); default 7, range 1–90.

parameters.name: TASK_STALE_PLANNED_DAYS
parameters.meaning: Days without a meaningful update after which a planned task is stale (OD-17); default 14, range 1–180.

parameters.name: TASK_RESCHEDULE_COUNT
parameters.meaning: Material due-date or deadline edits within the window that mark a task repeatedly rescheduled (OD-17); default 3, range 2–20.

parameters.name: TASK_RESCHEDULE_WINDOW_DAYS
parameters.meaning: Window for counting reschedules (OD-17); default 14, range 1–90.

parameters.name: TASK_REMINDERS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most scheduled reminders one person may hold on one task; default 10, range 1–50.

parameters.name: REMINDER_FIRE_BATCH_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most due reminders one worker run fires per workspace; later ones wait for the next run; default 500, range 1–5000.

parameters.name: TASK_SNOOZE_MAX_DAYS
parameters.meaning: Furthest a snooze may reach; default 365, range 1–3650.

parameters.name: BULK_ITEMS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most tasks in one bulk command's explicit set; default 200, range 1–1000.

parameters.name: BULK_PREVIEW_TTL_SECONDS
parameters.meaning: How long a bulk preview may be executed; default 600, range 60–3600.

parameters.name: UNDO_WINDOW_SECONDS
parameters.meaning: How long a reversible mutation can be undone; default 30, range 5–300.

parameters.name: DUPLICATE_WINDOW_DAYS
parameters.meaning: How far back deterministic duplicate matching looks; default 90, range 1–365.

parameters.name: DUPLICATE_CANDIDATES_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most duplicate candidates returned; default 5, range 1–20.

parameters.name: CAPTURE_TEXT_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most characters in one capture or note body; default 10000, range 100–50000.

parameters.name: CAPTURE_PASTE_LINES_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most candidate items one paste may create; default 100, range 1–500.

parameters.name: CAPTURE_LINKS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most links attached to one capture; default 10, range 0–50.

parameters.name: CAPTURE_FILES_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most file references attached to one capture (refused until 4E storage); default 10, range 0–50.

parameters.name: CAPTURE_PARSE_TOKENS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most tokens the deterministic parser examines per line; default 64, range 8–256.

parameters.name: CAPTURE_RATE_PER_MINUTE
parameters.meaning: Most capture commands one person may run per minute; default 60, range 1–600.

parameters.name: TRIAGE_BATCH_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most Inbox items one triage command may change; default 50, range 1–200.

parameters.name: INBOX_MERGE_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most Inbox items one merge may combine; default 20, range 2–100.

parameters.name: INTAKE_FORMS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most intake forms per brand; default 50, range 1–500.

parameters.name: INTAKE_SUBMISSIONS_PER_HOUR
parameters.meaning: Most submissions one person may make to one form per hour; default 20, range 1–1000.

parameters.name: QUERY_CONDITIONS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most conditions one view query may combine; default 40, range 1–200.

parameters.name: QUERY_DEPTH_MAX
parameters.meaning: Deepest nesting of AND/OR filter groups; default 3, range 1–6.

parameters.name: QUERY_SORTS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most sort keys in one view query; default 5, range 1–10.

parameters.name: QUERY_VALUES_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most values one filter condition may list; default 100, range 1–500.

parameters.name: QUERY_GROUPS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most groups one grouped query returns (more are reported as truncated); default 200, range 10–1000.

parameters.name: VIEW_COLUMNS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most visible columns in one view; default 20, range 1–50.

parameters.name: SAVED_VIEWS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most active saved views one person may own in a workspace; default 200, range 1–2000.

parameters.name: VIEW_PINS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most views pinned into one workspace or brand navigation; default 20, range 1–100.

parameters.name: EXPORT_ROWS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most rows one direct export of the current view may contain; larger views must be narrowed; default 5000, range 1–50000.

parameters.name: TIME_ENTRY_MAX_HOURS
parameters.meaning: Longest single time entry or timer run, in hours; default 24, range 1–24.

parameters.name: TIME_TIMER_MAX_HOURS
parameters.meaning: Hours after which a still-running timer is stopped automatically by the timer guard; default 12, range 1–24.

parameters.name: TIME_REPORT_RANGE_DAYS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Widest date range one time report, timesheet list, or export may cover, in days; default 366, range 7–1830.

parameters.name: TIME_REPORT_ROWS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most rows (groups) one planned-versus-actual report returns; default 500, range 10–5000.

parameters.name: TIME_EXPORT_ROWS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most time entries one direct export may contain; default 10000, range 100–50000.

parameters.name: TIME_TIMESHEET_ENTRIES_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most time entries one person may have in one timesheet period; default 2000, range 10–10000.

parameters.name: TIME_RUNAWAY_DISCOVERY_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most workspaces one timer-guard run examines; default 100, range 1–1000.

parameters.name: TIME_RUNAWAY_BATCH_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most runaway timers one timer-guard run stops per workspace; default 200, range 1–1000.

parameters.name: LAYOUT_ITEMS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most records one layout read (Gantt dependencies, milestones, portfolio progress, timesheet time) may name; default 200, range 10–1000.

parameters.name: WORKLOAD_DAYS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Longest date range one workload grid may cover; default 366, range 7–731.

parameters.name: ACTIVITY_RECORDS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most records whose activity one activity view reads (more are reported as truncated); default 500, range 10–5000.

parameters.name: TODAY_ITEMS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most Today commitments one person may have on one day; default 100, range 1–500.

parameters.name: TODAY_LIST_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most tasks one Today section (overdue, due today, upcoming deadlines) returns; default 50, range 5–200.

parameters.name: UPCOMING_DEADLINE_DAYS
parameters.meaning: How many days ahead Today lists upcoming deadlines; default 14, range 1–90.

parameters.name: WORK_BLOCKS_PER_DAY_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most work blocks one person may have starting on one local day; default 50, range 1–200.

parameters.name: WORK_BLOCKS_RANGE_DAYS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Widest range of days one work-block listing may cover; default 42, range 1–366.

parameters.name: BLOCK_SERIES_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most active recurring block series one person may have; default 50, range 1–500.

parameters.name: BLOCK_SERIES_HORIZON_DAYS
parameters.meaning: How many days ahead recurring work blocks are generated; default 28, range 1–180.

parameters.name: DAY_CLOSE_DISCOVERY_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most workspaces one day-close or block-series run examines; default 100, range 1–1000.

parameters.name: DAY_CLOSE_BATCH_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most person-days one day-close run records per workspace; default 200, range 1–1000.

parameters.name: AVAILABILITY_WINDOWS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most working windows one person may define per week; default 28, range 7–56.

parameters.name: TIME_OFF_ENTRIES_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most time-off entries one person may keep; default 500, range 10–5000.

parameters.name: BRAND_HOLIDAYS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most holidays one brand may keep; default 1000, range 10–10000.

parameters.name: CAPACITY_RANGE_DAYS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Longest date range one capacity read may cover; default 93, range 7–366.

parameters.name: CAPACITY_PEOPLE_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most people one team capacity read may include; default 100, range 1–1000.

parameters.name: COMMENT_BODY_MAX_CHARS
parameters.meaning: Longest comment body, in characters of extracted text; default 10000, range 100–50000.

parameters.name: COMMENT_EDIT_WINDOW_MINUTES
parameters.meaning: How long after posting an author may edit or delete their own comment (the OD-38 audit window); default 1440, range 5–10080. Moderators are not bound by it.

parameters.name: COMMENT_MENTIONS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most mentions one comment may carry; default 20, range 1–100.

parameters.name: COMMENTS_PER_RECORD_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most comments (roots and replies, deleted ones included) one record may hold; default 5000, range 100–50000.

parameters.name: COMMENT_RATE_PER_MINUTE
parameters.meaning: Most comments, replies, and edits one person may post per minute; default 30, range 1–600.

parameters.name: COMMENT_REPLIES_INLINE_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most replies a comment list returns inline under each thread (more are fetched by cursor); default 20, range 1–100.

parameters.name: FOLLOWERS_LIST_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most followers one record's follower list returns; default 200, range 10–1000.

parameters.name: REVIEW_REVIEWERS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most reviewers one review request may name; default 10, range 1–50.

parameters.name: NOTIFY_FANOUT_RECIPIENTS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most recipients one event fans out to (team mentions and follower lists are cut here); default 500, range 1–5000.

parameters.name: NOTIFY_DEDUPE_WINDOW_MINUTES
parameters.meaning: Width of the time bucket in which repeated notifications of one kind about one record from one actor collapse into one; default 60, range 1–1440.

parameters.name: NOTIFY_DELIVERY_BATCH_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most deliveries one sweep claims per workspace; default 100, range 1–1000.

parameters.name: NOTIFY_DELIVERY_MAX_ATTEMPTS
parameters.meaning: Attempts before a transient delivery failure is dead-lettered; default 6, range 1–20.

parameters.name: NOTIFY_RETRY_BASE_SECONDS
parameters.meaning: First retry delay; each later attempt doubles it; default 60, range 5–3600.

parameters.name: NOTIFY_RETRY_MAX_SECONDS
parameters.meaning: Longest retry delay; default 3600, range 60–86400.

parameters.name: NOTIFY_DIGEST_ITEMS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most items one digest lists (the rest stay in the notification centre); default 50, range 5–200.

parameters.name: NOTIFY_EMAIL_PER_HOUR_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most immediate emails one person receives per hour; more roll into their next digest; default 20, range 1–200.

parameters.name: NOTIFY_RETENTION_DAYS
parameters.meaning: Age after which a notification that is not saved is removed with its deliveries (a technical bound, not a published retention period: OD-36); default 365, range 30–3650.

parameters.name: NOTIFY_PREFERENCES_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most preference and mute rows one person may keep; default 200, range 10–1000.

parameters.name: NOTIFY_BROWSER_ACK_TTL_MINUTES
parameters.meaning: How long a browser delivery waits for the person's open browser to acknowledge it before it expires; default 30, range 1–1440.

parameters.name: NOTIFY_SEARCH_QUERY_MAX
parameters.meaning: Longest notification history search text; default 100, range 10–200.

parameters.name: NOTIFY_DISCOVERY_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most workspaces one notification sweep examines; default 100, range 1–1000.

parameters.name: NOTIFY_BULK_STATE_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most notifications one bulk state change names; default 200, range 1–1000.

parameters.name: NOTIFY_DEADLINES_BATCH_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most due-soon and overdue tasks one sweep considers per workspace; default 500, range 10–5000.

parameters.name: NOTIFY_FACTS_MAX_BYTES
parameters.meaning: Largest facts object a notification stores (scalars only, never titles or text); default 1024, range 128–4096.

parameters.name: DOCUMENT_BODY_MAX_BYTES
parameters.meaning: Largest canonical content of one document version, in bytes; default 262144, range 4096–2000000.

parameters.name: DOCUMENT_BLOCKS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most blocks in one document; default 2000, range 10–5000.

parameters.name: DOCUMENT_BLOCK_TEXT_MAX_CHARS
parameters.meaning: Longest text of one block; default 20000, range 100–50000.

parameters.name: DOCUMENT_TABLE_CELLS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most cells in one table block; default 1000, range 4–5000.

parameters.name: DOCUMENT_DEPTH_MAX
parameters.meaning: Deepest page nesting (a root is depth 0); default 6, range 1–16.

parameters.name: DOCUMENT_CHILDREN_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most direct subpages of one page; default 200, range 1–1000.

parameters.name: DOCUMENT_TREE_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most pages in one page tree; default 1000, range 10–5000.

parameters.name: DOCUMENT_VERSIONS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most versions one document keeps; default 1000, range 10–10000.

parameters.name: DOCUMENT_REFERENCES_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most links and mentions in one document; default 500, range 10–2000.

parameters.name: DOCUMENT_SUGGESTIONS_OPEN_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most open suggestions on one document; default 100, range 1–500.

parameters.name: DOCUMENT_EXPORT_PAGES_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most pages one export carries; default 100, range 1–500.

parameters.name: DOCUMENT_EXPORT_MAX_BYTES
parameters.meaning: Largest export, in bytes; default 5242880, range 65536–52428800.

parameters.name: DOCUMENT_REVIEW_HORIZON_DAYS
parameters.meaning: Furthest review date, in days from today; default 730, range 30–3650.

parameters.name: DOCUMENT_SAVE_RATE_PER_MINUTE
parameters.meaning: Most content saves one person makes per minute; default 60, range 1–600.

parameters.name: LIVE_EDITING_ENABLED
parameters.meaning: Whether live collaborative editing is offered; 0 falls back to versioned non-live editing; default 1.

parameters.name: LIVE_SESSION_TTL_SECONDS
parameters.meaning: How long a live editing session lasts without a heartbeat, poll, or operation; default 45, range 15–300.

parameters.name: LIVE_SESSIONS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most live editing sessions on one document; default 20, range 2–100.

parameters.name: LIVE_SESSIONS_PER_MEMBER_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most live sessions one person holds at once; default 5, range 1–20.

parameters.name: LIVE_OPS_BATCH_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most operations in one live request; default 50, range 1–200.

parameters.name: LIVE_POLL_WAIT_SECONDS
parameters.meaning: Longest a live poll waits for news before answering; default 20, range 0–30.

parameters.name: LIVE_OP_LOG_MAX
parameters.meaning: Operations kept so reconnecting editors can catch up; default 2000, range 100–10000.

parameters.name: LIVE_RATE_PER_MINUTE
parameters.meaning: Most live editing requests one person makes per minute; default 1200, range 10–6000.

parameters.name: DOCUMENT_EMBED_URL_MAX_CHARS
parameters.meaning: Longest address of an embedded image, video, or link; default 2048, range 128–8192.

parameters.name: FILE_UPLOAD_MAX_BYTES
parameters.meaning: Largest single upload in bytes; default 104857600 (100 MiB), range 1024–5368709120.

parameters.name: WORKSPACE_STORAGE_QUOTA_BYTES
parameters.meaning: Stored bytes one workspace may hold, counting bytes reserved by open upload sessions (a technical limit until plans set it, 10A); default 10737418240 (10 GiB), range 1048576–10995116277760.

parameters.name: FILE_COMPARE_MAX_BYTES
parameters.meaning: Largest text or code version compared line by line (larger versions compare by metadata); default 262144, range 1024–2097152.

parameters.name: FILE_SCAN_MAX_ATTEMPTS
parameters.meaning: Scan attempts before a failing scan marks the object scan_failed (downloads stay blocked); default 5, range 1–20.

parameters.name: FILE_VERSIONS_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most versions one file keeps; default 100, range 1–1000.

parameters.name: FILES_LIST_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most files one record holds and lists; default 200, range 10–1000.

parameters.name: DELIVERABLES_PER_TASK_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most deliverables one task holds; default 50, range 1–500.

parameters.name: FILE_DISCOVERY_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most workspaces one file sweep examines; default 100, range 1–1000.

parameters.name: FILE_EXPIRY_BATCH_MAX
parameters.meaning: Most expired upload sessions and object deletions one sweep handles per workspace; default 200, range 10–5000.
